g_policy.reason: The offer copy states the 30-minute reward before the optional game; the decline and ad-failure fields leave the reading experience unchanged.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 30 minutes without sponsored cards, not cash or a transferable equivalent.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger uses an article-open counter and a return to the home feed, not chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The adds and decline fields do not remove, lock, or cap a free reading feature.

g_brand_safety.reason: The placement is a dismissible banner on s01, a content-safe home feed, above the first story.

c1_revealed_value.reason: As a product change, the timed reward benefits the player while using the observed read-a-story flow f01.

c2_evidence.reason: The 'what makes it work here' field claims an AOL full-screen video ad appears after every third article, which no product-model element supports. It also states absolutely that the app has no paywall, limit, or currency, while the open question says only that none was seen on the home feed.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward expires after 30 minutes, and the proposal identifies no paid benefit it would grant permanently.

c5_moment.reason: The trigger places the banner on s01 after the reader returns from an article, rather than during a read.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The flow uses a sponsored game and unlocks the reward once play is confirmed; the failed-ad path grants nothing without confirmation.

c7_specific.reason: The idea uses the observed sponsored cards in the home feed (s01.e44) and article (s02.e13).

other_concern: The expiry note promises another break even when the reader may already have used both daily plays.
